list.title: API Keys
list.description: Manage API keys for authentication and authorization.
list.emptyFiltered: No API keys match these filters.

detail.description: API key details, live limits and usage.
detail.editDisabledHint: Editing is unavailable while the gateway is unreachable

limitsCard.title: Limits
limitsCard.description: Live configuration read from the gateway.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Traffic for this key and its live quota.
usage.noQuota: No quota configured for this key.
usage.noTraffic: No traffic recorded for this key in the selected range.

createdDialog.title: Copy your API key
createdDialog.description: This key is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. Store it somewhere safe.
createdDialog.copyFailed: Could not copy the key. Select it and copy it manually.

form.createDescription: Generate a key scoped to one API, with optional limits.
form.editDescription: Update the key name, expiry and limits.
form.noActiveApis: No active APIs yet. Create and activate an API first.
form.apiSyncHint: The API must be synced to the gateway before keys can be created for it.
form.apiNotEditable: A key cannot be moved to another API.
form.planNotEditable: A key's plan cannot be changed after creation.
form.planHint: Optional — a key with no plan works fully, using the limits below instead.
form.expiresHint: Valid through the end of this day (UTC). Leave blank for no expiry.
form.editQuotaWarning: Changing the quota resets this key's consumed quota for the current period.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters
errors.expiryMustBeFuture: Expiry must be a future date
errors.rateLimitInvalid: Rate limit must be a whole number of at least 0
errors.quotaInvalid: Quota must be a whole number of at least 1

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this API key?
revokeDialog.description: {keyName} will stop working immediately and is removed from the gateway. This cannot be undone.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate this API key?
rotateDialog.description: {keyName}'s current credential stops working immediately and is replaced with a new one, shown once.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this API key?
deleteDialog.description: {keyName} will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
